blocks.text: Paudon ke bohat se cells totipotent hain: aik cell naya paudha bana sakta hai, is liye mahireen aik transgenic cell se poora paudha uga sakte hain. Transgenic paudon ke bare maqasid yeh hain:

items: Keeron ki muzahimat: mitti ke bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis ke genes bohat se paudon (kapaas, chawal, makai, aaloo, tamatar, baingan, phool gobhi, band gobhi waghaira) mein dale gaye hain; yeh aise proteins banate jo nuqsandeh keere maarte lekin, kitab ke mutabiq, mufeed keeron ko nuqsan nahi dete.
Jari booti maar dawa ki muzahimat: bohat si faslein glyphosate, aik herbicide, ke khilaf mehfooz banayi gayi hain.

Behtar ghiza: ghizai iron aur vitamin A ki kami wale ilaqon ke liye transgenic 'golden rice'. Kitab kehti hai ke iron barhane ke liye phaliyon, phaphoond Aspergillus aur jangli chawal ke genes, aur beta-carotene (vitamin A ka pehla maadda) ke genes daffodil se dale gaye.
Hayati dawaen: GMO paude aur paudon ke cells cytokines, hormones, antibodies, enzymes aur vaccines banate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen silsila: daande jaisa mitti ka bacterium, Bacillus thuringiensis, surkh gene ke saath; akela Bt gene; nucleus mein gene wala paude ka cell; naya transgenic paudha; aur keera (caterpillar) jis par 'patta khata, mar jata' likha hai. Neeche note Bt genes wali faslein ginwata hai.
blocks.caption: Bt gene paudon ko keeron se mehfooz banata hai (Figure 20.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Paudon ke bohat se cells totipotent hain, is liye aik transgenic cell se poora paudha ugaya ja sakta hai. Mitti ke bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis ke genes kapaas, chawal, makai, aaloo, tamatar, baingan, phool gobhi, band gobhi aur doosre paudon mein dale gaye hain. Yeh paude aise proteins banate hain jo unhein khane wale keeron ko maar dete hain; kitab ke mutabiq yeh proteins doosre mufeed keeron ko nuqsan nahi dete.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq har saal iron ki kami 1.4 billion auraton ko mutasir karti hai, aur vitamin A ki kami 670,000 bachchon ki jaan leti aur bachpan ke na-qabil-e-ilaaj andhepan ke 500,000 cases ka sabab banti hai.

blocks.title: Golden rice ke baare mein
blocks.text: Naam 'golden rice' beta-carotene (vitamin A) wale chawal ka hai jis ke daane peele hote hain. Phaliyon, Aspergillus aur jangli chawal ke genes se bana iron wala chawal aik mutaliq lekin alag silsila tha.

blocks.prompt: Aik cell se transgenic paudha banana transgenic janwar se aasan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Paudon ke bohat se cells totipotent hain: aik badla hua cell poore paude mein ugaya ja sakta hai.

items: Totipotent paudon ke cells poore transgenic paude uga sakte hain.
Bt faslein keere maarti; glyphosate se mehfooz faslein; vitamin A ke liye golden rice (aur iron wala chawal).
Paude hayati dawaen bhi banate hain.
